Grit tumhe unstoppable banata hai.
Fear se aage badho.
Silence resistance ka form bhi ho sakta.
Khamoshi dheemi hai.
Taqat sangharsh se aati hai.
Grit quit karne se inkaar hai.
Khamoshi woh pause hai jo heal karta.
Mahaan dimaag vicharon par, aam dimaag ghatnaon par, aur chhote dimaag logon par baatchaat karte hain.
Sher ki dahad tez hoti hai, lekin uska chup rehna daravna hota hai.
Toofan ka saamna karo.
Khamoshi ek tarah ki resistance hai.
Khamoshi sab kuch saaf kar deti.
Himmat sabko prerit karti hai.
Hamesha bahadur raho.
Lakshya ke liye stamina grit hai.
Himmat victory ki maa hai.
Tum sab ghatnaon ko control nahi kar sakte, lekin tum apni reaction decide kar sakte ho.
Success aakhri nahi, failure maut nahi: aage badhne ki himmat hi maine rakhti hai.
Grit mahanata ka raaz hai.
Sabar kamyabi ka pul hai.
